cases.given: The defect spans dependent artifacts and one repair may expose another.
cases.expect: All surfaces use one schema name with a recorded two-iteration repair path.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the discrepancy is isolated and a single deterministic correction suffices
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Stop without certification when inconsistency does not decrease, repairs oscillate, or resolution requires changing a locked invariant.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: explicit invariants, dependency recheck, and bounded exit

cases.given: A second repair restores one file but reintroduces the first contradiction elsewhere.
cases.expect: Detect oscillation, stop the loop, and report the unresolved invariant conflict.
